info.title: Digisign - Create
info.description: Custom connector for the Digisign REST API focused on envelope and document creation. Allows exchanging credentials for a token, creating envelope drafts, uploading files, linking documents to envelopes, performing unified document uploads, adding recipients (Signers, Approvers, CCs), adding signature tags, sending envelopes, and making restricted universal API calls (GET/POST).
